**Implementation note:** Causal Gaussian HMM and mixture regimes; not wired as a --regime.

## Description

Infer latent market states (such as calm, trending or high-volatility) from returns/volatility and switch strategies or exposure.

## Where it may fit

Markets whose return/volatility distributions have recurring, statistically distinguishable regimes.

## Vehicles

Multi-asset portfolios, tactical allocation, systematic funds.

## Required data

Return series, volatility/range features, model training window, regime count and execution-cost data.

## Caveats

Regimes are inferred, not observed; state labels and transition probabilities may be unstable out of sample.
